evals.prompt: 把一套 7 张真实生产的耳机电商详情图发布到灵感发现，要求用户点开后能看到每张真实提示词，点击做同款能恢复商品图和整套提示词。请给出 manifest 和验证步骤。
evals.expected_output: A valid production manifest with seven distinct output prompts, source product role, mosaic cover, remix data, and end-to-end verification.
expectations: Uses a mosaic or auto cover for the seven-image suite
Preserves per-output prompt, taskId, requestKey, and ratio
Preserves the product source role and remix prompt

evals.prompt: 我只生成了两张模特上身图，要放进案例，不要假装成完整套图。第二张请求遇到 524，但后台任务还在。应该怎么恢复和发布？
evals.expected_output: A single-cover two-image case and a durable status recovery process that does not resubmit or double-charge.
expectations: Selects a normal single cover for two outputs
Checks durable status with the same request key after 524
Does not resubmit the image provider request

evals.prompt: 审查一个准备上线的案例：所有 6 张图的 description 都是‘展示本套方案中的视觉内容’，sourceAssets 里缺少参考模特，但做同款按钮已经接好了。判断能不能发布并给修复清单。
evals.expected_output: Rejects publication and requires exact per-image prompts plus the missing reference-model source role before remix can be considered reproducible.
expectations: Requires the missing reference model source asset and role
Requires validating both prompt and material restoration
Does not claim the case is reproducible before the fixes
